name: ATELIER / Objects of light
description: An original, fully editable editorial lighting campaign. Three artboards and complete English, Chinese and Japanese content variants.

pages.name: 01 / Editorial landing
pages.css: *{box-sizing:border-box}h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a94d24;outline-offset:6px}.atelier{--paper:#f3eee6;--ink:#30291f;--accent:#a54c28;--line:#cfc6b9;--sans:Arial,'Noto Sans CJK SC','Noto Sans CJK JP',sans-serif;--serif:Georgia,'Noto Serif CJK SC','Noto Serif CJK JP',serif;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);min-height:100%;overflow:hidden;container-type:inline-size}.nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:0 64px;height:100px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:24px}.brand{font-size:29px;letter-spacing:7px;font-weight:500}.nav-caption{font:italic 18px var(--serif)}.micro{font:10px/1.7 var(--sans);letter-spacing:1.5px}.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:710px;padding-left:64px;gap:20px}.hero-copy{padding:70px 30px 48px 0;position:relative}.eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.6px;line-height:1.8}.hero h1{font:400 100px/.98 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-5px;white-space:pre-line;margin:34px 0 29px;overflow-wrap:break-word}.description{font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;max-width:355px;color:#665c50}.cta{display:inline-block;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #8a7965;background:none;padding:0 0 10px;margin-top:31px;text-align:left;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2px}.hero .index{margin-top:66px;color:#7b6d5b}.scene{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 24%,#f2d9b1 0,#d9b88b 42%,#b98c64 100%);isolation:isolate}.hero .scene{margin-top:26px;min-height:660px}.wall-light{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(125deg,transparent 34%,#fff2ca60 34.1%,#fff2ca08 58%,transparent 58.1%)}.surface{position:absolute;left:-10%;right:-10%;top:71%;height:50%;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#d6b58d,#c09971 68%);transform:rotate(-8deg);box-shadow:0 -1px 0 #e9cda6}.shadow{position:absolute;width:73%;height:12%;left:25%;top:79%;border-radius:50%;background:#48342247;filter:blur(13px);transform:rotate(-14deg)}.lamp{position:absolute;width:72%;height:69%;left:14%;top:10%;z-index:2}.lamp-foot{position:absolute;left:30%;width:40%;height:7%;bottom:1%;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#796955,#d2cec2 20%,#f0ede1 47%,#a79983 80%,#786957);box-shadow:0 5px 4px #63513c40}.lamp-stem{position:absolute;left:47%;width:7%;height:47%;top:47%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#746c5d,#eae5d7 34%,#aba38f 76%,#746650);border-radius:0 0 4px 4px}.lamp-shade{position:absolute;width:100%;height:61%;top:4%;border-radius:50% 50% 13% 13% / 75% 75% 20% 20%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 48% 88%,#fff3c5 0,#ffce79 18%,#eaa657 40%,#b96c2f 67%,#8b4526 100%);box-shadow:inset 8px 0 11px #fff2c65c,inset -13px 1px 19px #542a1e62,0 18px 25px #6d411e27}.shade-rim{position:absolute;left:1%;width:98%;height:14%;top:51%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#ffe1a1 0,#f2bf73 65%,#b77a3e 95%);border:2px solid #c88c4c;box-shadow:0 7px 18px #eeb9704d}.shine{position:absolute;left:12%;top:15%;width:11%;height:32%;border-radius:70%;transform:rotate(28deg);background:linear-gradient(#fff2ca80,#fff2ca00);filter:blur(4px)}.scene-caption{position:absolute;bottom:20px;left:27px;right:27px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.2px;z-index:3}.scene-no{position:absolute;right:28px;top:25px;font:italic 36px var(--serif);color:#684a30}.strip{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:21px 64px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:24px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px}.story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;padding:55px 64px 42px;gap:75px}.story h2{font:43px/1.12 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-1.3px;white-space:pre-line;margin-top:15px}.story-description{padding-top:27px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.9;color:#665c50;max-width:490px}.details{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:28px;margin:0 64px 52px}.detail-art{height:285px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.detail-art.scene{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0,#e2d2b9,#c2b49a)}.detail-art .lamp{width:45%;left:28%;height:105%;top:1%}.detail-art .surface{top:85%}.detail-art .scene-caption{top:19px;bottom:auto;left:22px}.material-art{background:#ded7ca;padding:24px;isolation:isolate}.material-ring{position:absolute;left:21%;top:-18%;width:75%;height:143%;border:53px solid #ad5e2c;border-radius:50%;transform:rotate(38deg);box-shadow:inset 8px 9px 14px #713e242e,7px 13px 20px #7e582432;background:transparent}.metal-disk{position:absolute;width:42%;height:67%;right:1%;bottom:-22%;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(#b4ac9b,#eee9dd,#97907f,#e1daca,#b4ac9b);box-shadow:-13px -4px 22px #71665126}.material-art .micro{position:relative;z-index:2}.detail-copy{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px;padding-top:16px}.detail-copy h3{font:22px var(--serif)}.detail-copy p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;color:#665c50;margin-top:6px;max-width:340px}.detail-arrow{font-size:24px;font-weight:400}.footer{background:#393c30;color:#f3eee6;padding:35px 64px 23px}.footer-title{font:52px/1.15 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-1.6px;margin:17px 0 32px}.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid #737363;padding-top:19px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px}.mobile .nav{margin:0 24px;height:80px}.mobile .brand{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:4px}.mobile .nav-caption{font-size:14px}.mobile .nav .micro{display:none}.mobile .hero{display:block;padding:0}.mobile .hero-copy{padding:35px 24px 30px}.mobile .hero h1{font-size:65px;letter-spacing:-3px;margin:24px 0}.mobile .eyebrow{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1px}.mobile .description{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8}.mobile .hero .index{margin-top:27px;font-size:8px}.mobile .hero .scene{height:420px;min-height:0;margin:0 16px 23px}.mobile .strip{padding:17px 24px;font-size:8px;gap:20px}.mobile .strip>*:nth-child(2){display:none}.mobile .story{display:block;padding:34px 24px 26px}.mobile .story h2{font-size:36px}.mobile .story-description{padding-top:21px;font-size:13px}.mobile .details{display:block;margin:0 24px 34px}.mobile .detail-art{height:255px}.mobile .detail-card+ .detail-card{margin-top:29px}.mobile .footer{padding:30px 24px 22px}.mobile .footer-title{font-size:35px;letter-spacing:-1px;margin-bottom:25px}.mobile .footer-bottom{font-size:7px;gap:15px}.poster{position:relative;height:100%;padding:47px;background:#d9b78c;isolation:isolate}.poster>.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1}.poster>.scene .lamp{width:55%;height:67%;left:35%;top:25%}.poster>.scene .surface{top:80%}.poster>.scene .scene-caption{display:none}.poster .nav{height:55px;margin:0;border-bottom:1px solid #907859}.poster .brand{font-size:31px}.poster-title{font:90px/.98 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-4px;white-space:pre-line;position:relative;margin-top:60px}.poster-bottom{position:absolute;bottom:43px;left:47px;right:47px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:30px}.poster-bottom h3{font:26px var(--serif);margin-bottom:10px}.poster-bottom .micro{max-width:290px}.poster .eyebrow{margin-top:24px}.hero>*,.story>*,.details>*,.footer-bottom>*{min-width:0}button,.detail-copy p,.footer-title{overflow-wrap:anywhere}

props.text: Light that brings a room together. Meet Sol, a sculptural table lamp inspired by the warmth of the late afternoon.

children.name: Artwork / editable amber glass table lamp

props.text: A single curve. An honest material. A glow you can settle into. Sol balances an expressive silhouette with the simple pleasure of a well-lit corner.

children.name: Artwork / editable amber glass table lamp
Artwork / glass and brushed metal study

props.text: A quiet conversation between translucent glass and cool, brushed metal.
